chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her mid-20s wearing a mustard-yellow hijab and a long dark-green dress with white cuffs
chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man in his late 20s with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a burgundy hoodie and light grey jeans
chars.MOTHER: an older Moroccan woman wearing a navy-blue djellaba with white floral embroidery and a white headscarf
chars.FRIEND: a young Moroccan man with curly hair wearing a black leather jacket over a white t-shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Modern Moroccan apartment living room in Casablanca with a traditional sedari sofa. WIFE sits on the sofa secretly writing in a small notebook, hiding it with her arm; HUSBAND peeks curiously from the doorway, eyebrow raised. Playful curious mood, 2D animated storybook style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan home kitchen with blue tiles. WIFE kindly helps MOTHER cook, both smiling, WIFE stirring a tagine while MOTHER pats her shoulder. Warm cozy mood.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Family dinner around a round low Moroccan table with tea glasses and bread. HUSBAND and MOTHER talk and laugh while WIFE sits quietly, silent, looking down at her plate. Gentle awkward mood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Small apartment balcony with potted plants and a city view. WIFE holds a small brown leather notebook close to her chest and writes in it secretly, glancing over her shoulder. Mysterious mood.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan street cafe terrace with mint tea glasses on the table. FRIEND laughs loudly and teases HUSBAND, pointing at him, while HUSBAND shrugs, embarrassed. Comic mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Dark bedroom at night lit by blue moonlight. WIFE sleeps in bed; HUSBAND tiptoes and quietly takes the small brown leather notebook from the bedside drawer, looking back at her nervously. Suspenseful but playful mood.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Dark hallway at night. HUSBAND sits on the floor reading the open small brown notebook by phone light, eyes wide and mouth open in shock; WIFE asleep visible through the bedroom door behind him. Suspense.
